digest.en: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle, dominates headlines in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the World Health Organization reports over 3,000 cases and 2,000 deaths. Meanwhile, in the United States, U.S. Senate leaders have reached a funding deal to avoid a government shutdown during the election season. Chaos at the Ceuta border crossing continues to affect Moroccans stranded on the streets.
